name: Fogo - [MMMM]
description: Fogo burns. What more need you know? Fogo Dano presents a singular challenge for the industrious surgeon; it is rather difficult to reattach a limb turned to ash. You may also find your patients dangerously fatigued with heat exhaustion or heat stroke. It need not be said that if you happen to come across a patient who is still actively on Fogo...put them out!

results.description: You just can't take the heat. Any exposure causes you to sweat, turn beet red, and become quickly fatigued. You have disadvantage on Constitution checks and Saving Throws made to resist the environmental effects of heat.
results.name: Heat Intolerance

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Tabela de Membros Grandes}. The limb is charred black, completely covered in extensive burns, and sem funcionamento . Se não for tratado dentro de 24 horas the limb will necrotize and fall off in [[1d4]] days (after which it is ausente ).

Tratamento - A DC 21 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia de Membro. You get 1 check for this Cirurgia; if you do not meet the DC on the first check, the limb is lost.
results.name: Imolado Membro

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Tabela de Apêndices Pequenos}. The appendage is charred black, completely covered in extensive burns, and sem funcionamento . Se não for tratado dentro de 24 horas the appendage will necrotize and fall off in [[1d4]] days (after which it is ausente ).

Tratamento - A DC 21 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia de Membro. You get 1 check for this Cirurgia; if you do not meet the DC on the first check, the appendage is lost.
results.name: Imolado Apêndice

results.description:
You have a deep burn penetrating through your skin, resulting in a cracked, red wound. While on initiative you take 1 Fogo Dano for every 5 feet of movement. In addition, you take [[/damage 1d4 fire]] every time you take an action or Bonus Action. This injury lasts [[1d8]] days.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 16]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d8]] days.
results.name: Terceiro Grau Queimadura

results.description:
Sweat breaks out on your brow, your pulse is thready, and your muscles feel weak. Você sofre 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion]{exhaustion} .

Tratamento - A Long Rest or the Greater Restoration spell removes this exhaustion as usual.
results.name: Heat Exhaustion

results.description:
An angry red burn flashes over your skin. It's tender and painful to move. While on initiative you take 1 Fogo Dano per 10 feet of movement. Esta lesão cicatriza in [[1d6]] days.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 10]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d6]] days.
results.name: Primeiro Grau Queimadura

results.description:
It's so hot you feel faint. Your muscles are cramping. It feels as if your blood is about to boil in your body. Você sofre 2 levels of &Reference[exhaustion]{exhaustion}.

Tratamento - A Long Rest or the Greater Restoration spell removes this exhaustion as usual.
results.name: Heat Stroke

results.description:
Your skin bubbles and blisters as the burning flashes over it. While on initiative you take 1 Fogo Dano per 5 feet of movement. Esta lesão cicatriza in [[1d8]] days.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 12]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d8]] days.
results.name: Segundo Grau Queimadura

results.description: Role no @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Esta área do seu corpo fica com uma cicatriz de queimadura enrugada e enrugada.
results.name: Cicatriz de queim

results.description: Role no @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Esta área do seu corpo fica com uma cicatriz de marca definida e ligeiramente deprimida.
results.name: Marca

results.description:
You. Are. On. Fogo. Dancing flames lick around your body. At the beginning of your turn, you take Fogo Dano scaled to the Dano that caused the Lesão Persistente: 1-10 Dano ( [[1d2]] ), 11-20 Dano ( [[1d4]] ), 21-30 Dano ( [[1d6]] ), 31-40 Dano ( [[1d8]] ), > 40 Dano ( [[1d10]] ).

Tratamento - You may use an action to extinguish the flames.
results.name: Ignited

results.description:
The temperature around you skyrockets, flash-heating everything nearby. Any flammable objects being worn or wielded are ignited. You drop anything metal you are carrying in sudden shock.

Tratamento - You may extinguish any worn or wielded items that were ignited with a Bonus Action. If you attempt to pick up any dropped items, make a Constitution Saving Throw (DC equals half the Dano that caused the lingering injury or 10, whichever number is higher) to brave the heat and retrieve them.
results.name: Escaldantes Temperatures

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. In a freak instance of chance, the heat has interacted with a thread of natural magic within you. This area of your body fica permanentemente hot (though to you it feels pleasantly warm) and radiates a faint aura of Transmutation. You have advantage on Constitution checks and Saving Throws made to resist the environmental effects of heat. You may suppress this effect by maintaining Concentração.
results.name: Interior Fogo

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Tabela de Apêndices Pequenos}. The blazing fires have scoured through until nothing but ash remains. The appendage is ausente and the resulting wound is cauterized.
results.name: Incinerado Apêndice

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Tabela de Membros Grandes}. The voracious Fogo has devoured your limb, leaving nothing but smoking cinders in its wake. The limb is ausente , and the resulting wound is cauterized
results.name: Incinerado Membro

results.description:
Você inala o ar escaldante ao seu redor e ele queima um caminho direto até seus pulmões. Seu paladar e olfato são __X1X __ sem funcionamento __ X2X__ Se não forem tratados dentro de 24 horas, eles ficarão permanentemente ausente .

Tratamento - A DC 20 Cirurgia Teste de Resistência Sense
results.name: Queimadura das Vias Aéreas
